checklist_findings.question: Lengde på turneringer?
checklist_findings.finding: duration_summary shows min 100 / max 155 minutes, no missing durations. booking_feasibility_warnings lists 23 tournaments below the 120-min governing floor, but every one carries an accepted_exception backed by calendar_event_association (real, calendar-confirmed booked intervals) -- these are accepted facts, not silent violations. Two additional real short bookings (60 and 80 min vs. planned 155/100) were investigated this session and the affected tournaments (rvv-0116, rvv-0173) were cancelled as unconfirmed/lost ice rather than misrepresented as booked at the planned duration.
evidence: booking_feasibility_warnings_count=23, all accepted_booking_interval=true with calendar_event_association authority

checklist_findings.question: Er det faktisk ledig tid på is?
checklist_findings.finding: This was the primary focus of the current session: live re-scraped every club calendar (Frisk Asker, Holmen, Kongsberg, Jutul, Skien, Ringerike, Jar), reconciled booking evidence, and cancelled 5 tournaments (rvv-0033, rvv-0044, rvv-0057, rvv-0116, rvv-0173) that could not be confirmed against real host calendars or had a real, unresolved external-conflict flag from their placement with no host confirmation obtained. All remaining changed/eligible tournaments in this export's delta are either confirmed_booked/manually_booked against real calendar evidence, or are the earlier-cancelled Dragons Cup tournaments (rvv-0038/rvv-0078).
evidence: 5 unconfirmed tournaments cancelled this session with documented reasons

checklist_findings.finding: export_consistency_summary shows matches_plan=true for csv_games, csv_overview, csv_team_counts, ical and excel, with row/event counts matching the canonical plan exactly (2337 CSV rows incl. 26 pause rows, 183 overview rows, 183 ical events). export_parity.json separately reports PASS for the xlsx/html pair, bound to the current canonical revision.

checklist_findings.question: Ser harnesset andre materielle problemer eller manglende regler vi ikke allerede har tenkt på?
checklist_findings.finding: No new material problem or missing planner rule found. This session independently: (1) found and fixed two real code defects in reconciliation replay (missing reject_booking_evidence decision-only classification, and a shallow-copy history-list aliasing bug that let a rejected booking assertion corrupt canonical history) with regression tests, both merged before this export was generated; (2) reconciled calendar evidence across all 7 host clubs; (3) resolved the four active Frisk Asker Dragons/Warriors Cup request constraints via cancellation and a legal roster swap; (4) cancelled 5 genuinely-unconfirmed tournaments rather than leaving them ambiguous. The remaining full-season diagnostic debt (hosting_balance_imbalances, participation shortfalls, 9 unplaced Jar hosting obligations) is well-characterized, has explicit avoidability/classification metadata for every instance, and traces to real registered-team-pool sizes and ice-time scarcity investigated directly (e.g. a full bounded search on one Jar unplaced obligation found all 497 candidate placements fail for the same ice-time-floor reason) -- not to an undiscovered planner or export bug.
evidence: two code fixes merged this session with regression tests
9 unplaced Jar obligations individually search-exhausted, not merely unattempted
